data.body: Consideration: [Maintainability/Consumer Impact] The dead-weight scan must check FOUR consumer surfaces, not just local hook callers: (1) plugins/dso/hooks/* and pre-commit-* scripts, (2) .github/workflows/*.yml (CI may invoke ostensibly-local scripts), (3) .claude/scripts/dso shim dispatch table (host projects on enforcement.strategy=local still consume these), (4) plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh and validate.sh --ci paths. A script with zero local-hook consumers but one CI or shim consumer must be ANNOTATED, not deleted. Done sub-item: scan output enumerates consumers found in all four surfaces per candidate.
